summary: The repo-bootstrap branch delivers exactly the minimal baseline its spec commits to, and every acceptance criterion verifies against the current HEAD. AC1: `.claude/workflow.json` carries only `baseBranch`, `branchPrefix`, and a single-`echo` `testCommand` that exits 0 while identifying itself as a deliberate no-op. AC3: `.gitignore` covers `.env`, the whole `.env.*` family (with the `!.env.example` negation verified working via `git check-ignore`), the Next.js artifacts at any depth, `.vercel/`, and `reviews/.*.tmp`. AC4: the config parses to exactly the three permitted keys with neither retired field. AC5: `LICENSE` is verbatim MIT with the copyright line filled. AC6: `reviews/audit-2026-08-30.md` is tracked. AC7: the enumerated diff against the stack base shows only `.claude/workflow.json`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `.gitignore`, and `v-tina-user-stories.md`. AC2 is satisfied in substance: the README states what v-tina is and names the intended stack, and the one prior process observation — that the README still called the purpose 'forthcoming' after the story was committed — was already raised at review/6 and fixed in HEAD by pointing the README at the committed specification, matching the recorded scope amendment, so it is not re-raised here. No correctness or hidden-failure defects found.
